cover.coreProposition: Business effect identity should remain stable across GUI, CLI, and tool/MCP surface switches over the same target state; surface-specific evidence belongs to one effect-centered provenance chain, while authorization, idempotency, and commit evidence remain separate gates.
cover.visualMetaphor: Three distinct control instruments—gesture arc, command ribbon, and tool connector—converge on one luminous state capsule carrying a single continuous identity trace.
cover.semanticObject: One central glass state capsule reached by three visually distinct but continuous trajectories
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a deep navy field, cyan gesture arc, violet command ribbon, teal tool connector, one amber unresolved observation, strong central focus, perspective depth, and ample negative space
